title: N-th Tribonacci Number
description: Calculate the nth Tribonacci number where T0=0, T1=1, T2=1, and Tn+3 = Tn + Tn+1 + Tn+2.
pseudocode:
1. if n < 2 return n
2. if n == 2 return 1
3. dp = [0, 1, 1]
4. for i from 3 to n:
5.   next = dp[0] + dp[1] + dp[2]
6.   dp = [dp[1], dp[2], next]
7. return dp[2]

steps.note: Initialize DP array with base cases [T0, T1, T2].
Loop finishes, return the last element.
